type-a-uncertainty.title: Type A Uncertainty Calculator
type-a-uncertainty.intro: Evaluate experimental standard deviation and the standard uncertainty of the mean from repeated observations using Bessel's formula.

en.title: Type A Uncertainty Calculator
en.intro: Evaluate experimental standard deviation and the standard uncertainty of the mean from repeated observations using Bessel's formula.

std-dev-type-a.title: Type A Standard Uncertainty Calculator
std-dev-type-a.intro: Compute u_A = s/√n from sample standard deviation and the number of independent measurements (statistical evaluation).

en.title: Type A Standard Uncertainty Calculator
en.intro: Compute u_A = s/√n from sample standard deviation and the number of independent measurements (statistical evaluation).

type-b-uncertainty.title: Type B Uncertainty Calculator
type-b-uncertainty.intro: Compute u_B = a/k from a half-width a given by a calibration certificate, handbook or experience and a coverage factor k (non-statistical evaluation).

en.title: Type B Uncertainty Calculator
en.intro: Compute u_B = a/k from a half-width a given by a calibration certificate, handbook or experience and a coverage factor k (non-statistical evaluation).

grr-study.title: Gauge R&R Study Calculator
grr-study.intro: Evaluate the combined repeatability and reproducibility share in a measurement system and judge whether the system is acceptable.

en.title: Gauge R&R Study Calculator
en.intro: Evaluate the combined repeatability and reproducibility share in a measurement system and judge whether the system is acceptable.

uncertainty-propagation-product.title: Uncertainty Propagation (Product/Quotient)
uncertainty-propagation-product.intro: Combine the relative uncertainties of two variables as u_y/|y| = √(Σ(u_i/x_i)²) for a product or quotient model.

en.title: Uncertainty Propagation (Product/Quotient)
en.intro: Combine the relative uncertainties of two variables as u_y/|y| = √(Σ(u_i/x_i)²) for a product or quotient model.

uncertainty-propagation-sum.title: Uncertainty Propagation (Linear Combination)
uncertainty-propagation-sum.intro: Combine sensitivity coefficients and component uncertainties as u_c = √(Σ(c_i·u_i)²) for a linear measurement model.

en.title: Uncertainty Propagation (Linear Combination)
en.intro: Combine sensitivity coefficients and component uncertainties as u_c = √(Σ(c_i·u_i)²) for a linear measurement model.

guard-band-95.title: Guard Band Calculator (95%)
guard-band-95.intro: Compute the one-sided guard band GB = 1.65·U from the expanded uncertainty to reserve safety margin inside specification limits when making conformity decisions.

en.title: Guard Band Calculator (95%)
en.intro: Compute the one-sided guard band GB = 1.65·U from the expanded uncertainty to reserve safety margin inside specification limits when making conformity decisions.

measurement-cgk.title: Measurement Capability Index Cgk
measurement-cgk.intro: Compute Cgk = min(USL−x̄, x̄−LSL)/(3·s), a bias-aware capability index measuring whether a system is both accurate and precise.

en.title: Measurement Capability Index Cgk
en.intro: Compute Cgk = min(USL−x̄, x̄−LSL)/(3·s), a bias-aware capability index measuring whether a system is both accurate and precise.

least-count-error.title: Least Count Reading Error Calculator
least-count-error.intro: Estimate the reading error introduced by ±half of the least count for instruments such as vernier calipers and micrometers.

en.title: Least Count Reading Error Calculator
en.intro: Estimate the reading error introduced by ±half of the least count for instruments such as vernier calipers and micrometers.

resolution-uncertainty.title: Resolution Uncertainty Calculator
resolution-uncertainty.intro: Compute the uncertainty introduced by the last displayed digit of a digital instrument, assuming a rectangular distribution.

en.title: Resolution Uncertainty Calculator
en.intro: Compute the uncertainty introduced by the last displayed digit of a digital instrument, assuming a rectangular distribution.

ndc-number.title: Number of Distinct Categories (NDC)
ndc-number.intro: Compute NDC = 1.41 × PV/GRR from part-to-part variation and measurement system error; NDC ≥ 5 is considered effective.

en.title: Number of Distinct Categories (NDC)
en.intro: Compute NDC = 1.41 × PV/GRR from part-to-part variation and measurement system error; NDC ≥ 5 is considered effective.

combined-uncertainty.title: Combined Uncertainty Calculator
combined-uncertainty.intro: Combine independent uncertainty components by root-sum-square to evaluate the total uncertainty of a measurement system.

en.title: Combined Uncertainty Calculator
en.intro: Combine independent uncertainty components by root-sum-square to evaluate the total uncertainty of a measurement system.

roundness-deviation.title: Roundness Deviation Calculator
roundness-deviation.intro: Approximate roundness error from the maximum and minimum radii measured around a circumference (minimum zone method) for shafts and precision rotating parts.

en.title: Roundness Deviation Calculator
en.intro: Approximate roundness error from the maximum and minimum radii measured around a circumference (minimum zone method) for shafts and precision rotating parts.

dimensional-tolerance.title: Dimensional Tolerance Calculator
dimensional-tolerance.intro: Derive tolerance size and upper/lower limit dimensions from nominal size and upper/lower deviations for tolerance design and drawing checks.

en.title: Dimensional Tolerance Calculator
en.intro: Derive tolerance size and upper/lower limit dimensions from nominal size and upper/lower deviations for tolerance design and drawing checks.

tolerance-stackup-worst.title: Worst-Case Tolerance Stack-up Calculator
tolerance-stackup-worst.intro: Sum the absolute tolerances of all components in a linear dimension chain to conservatively assess assembly clearance or interference.

en.title: Worst-Case Tolerance Stack-up Calculator
en.intro: Sum the absolute tolerances of all components in a linear dimension chain to conservatively assess assembly clearance or interference.

flatness-deviation.title: Flatness Deviation Calculator
flatness-deviation.intro: Approximate flatness error from the highest and lowest measurement points on a surface (minimum zone method) for machined parts and surface plates.

en.title: Flatness Deviation Calculator
en.intro: Approximate flatness error from the highest and lowest measurement points on a surface (minimum zone method) for machined parts and surface plates.

expanded-uncertainty.title: Expanded Uncertainty Calculator
expanded-uncertainty.intro: Compute expanded uncertainty U = k × u_c from combined standard uncertainty and coverage factor, giving the confidence interval of a measurement result.

en.title: Expanded Uncertainty Calculator
en.intro: Compute expanded uncertainty U = k × u_c from combined standard uncertainty and coverage factor, giving the confidence interval of a measurement result.

effective-dof-welch.title: Effective Degrees of Freedom (Welch-Satterthwaite)
effective-dof-welch.intro: Compute effective degrees of freedom ν_eff = (Σu_i²)² / Σ(u_i⁴/ν_i) from uncertainty components and their degrees of freedom.

en.title: Effective Degrees of Freedom (Welch-Satterthwaite)
en.intro: Compute effective degrees of freedom ν_eff = (Σu_i²)² / Σ(u_i⁴/ν_i) from uncertainty components and their degrees of freedom.

calibration-uncertainty.title: Calibration Uncertainty Calculator
calibration-uncertainty.intro: Combine the uncertainty contributed by the reference standard with the repeatability uncertainty by root-sum-square to obtain the expanded uncertainty for a calibration report.

en.title: Calibration Uncertainty Calculator
en.intro: Combine the uncertainty contributed by the reference standard with the repeatability uncertainty by root-sum-square to obtain the expanded uncertainty for a calibration report.

measurement-cg.title: Measurement Capability Index Cg
measurement-cg.intro: Compute Cg = (USL − LSL)/(6·s) from specification limits and measurement process standard deviation; Cg ≥ 1.33 is generally required.

en.title: Measurement Capability Index Cg
en.intro: Compute Cg = (USL − LSL)/(6·s) from specification limits and measurement process standard deviation; Cg ≥ 1.33 is generally required.

drift-rate.title: Drift Rate Calculator
drift-rate.intro: Compute drift rate as (x₂ − x₁)/Δt from two readings and the elapsed time to assess instrument stability during periodic verification.

en.title: Drift Rate Calculator
en.intro: Compute drift rate as (x₂ − x₁)/Δt from two readings and the elapsed time to assess instrument stability during periodic verification.

relative-uncertainty.title: Relative Uncertainty Calculator
relative-uncertainty.intro: Compute relative uncertainty u_rel = u/|x| as a dimensionless ratio for expressing measurement precision as a percentage.

en.title: Relative Uncertainty Calculator
en.intro: Compute relative uncertainty u_rel = u/|x| as a dimensionless ratio for expressing measurement precision as a percentage.

bias-percent.title: Relative Bias Calculator
bias-percent.intro: Compute relative bias (%) as (x − x_ref)/x_ref × 100% to evaluate the relative level of measurement deviation.

en.title: Relative Bias Calculator
en.intro: Compute relative bias (%) as (x − x_ref)/x_ref × 100% to evaluate the relative level of measurement deviation.

precision-tolerance-ratio.title: Precision-to-Tolerance Ratio Calculator
precision-tolerance-ratio.intro: Compute PTR = 6·s/Tol from measurement standard deviation and part tolerance; PTR < 0.1 indicates the equipment is precise enough.

en.title: Precision-to-Tolerance Ratio Calculator
en.intro: Compute PTR = 6·s/Tol from measurement standard deviation and part tolerance; PTR < 0.1 indicates the equipment is precise enough.

bias-absolute.title: Absolute Bias Calculator
bias-absolute.intro: Compute absolute bias as x − x_ref from a measured value and the reference standard value to evaluate measurement system deviation.

en.title: Absolute Bias Calculator
en.intro: Compute absolute bias as x − x_ref from a measured value and the reference standard value to evaluate measurement system deviation.

gauge-reproducibility.title: Gauge Reproducibility Calculator
gauge-reproducibility.intro: Compute reproducibility σ_o from the range of operator averages divided by the d₂* coefficient to quantify operator-to-operator variation.

en.title: Gauge Reproducibility Calculator
en.intro: Compute reproducibility σ_o from the range of operator averages divided by the d₂* coefficient to quantify operator-to-operator variation.

grr-percent.title: %GRR Calculator
grr-percent.intro: Compute %GRR = GRR/Tolerance × 100% from measurement system error and tolerance band width; generally <10% is excellent and >30% requires improvement.

en.title: %GRR Calculator
en.intro: Compute %GRR = GRR/Tolerance × 100% from measurement system error and tolerance band width; generally <10% is excellent and >30% requires improvement.

gauge-repeatability.title: Gauge Repeatability Calculator
gauge-repeatability.intro: Compute repeatability standard deviation σ_r = R̄/d₂ from the average range of repeated readings using the range method for measurement system analysis (MSA).

en.title: Gauge Repeatability Calculator
en.intro: Compute repeatability standard deviation σ_r = R̄/d₂ from the average range of repeated readings using the range method for measurement system analysis (MSA).
